北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京中雨，出门记得带伞，小心路滑，保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has moderate rain. Bring an umbrella, stay warm and be careful on slippery roads!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有风，体感舒适。注意防风，享受好天气！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and breezy, feels pleasant. Mind the wind and enjoy your day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，气温舒适。阳光正好，心情也要美美的！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant. What a beautiful day to lift your spirits!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿，体感略闷。注意通风，保持舒爽哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and humid. It feels a bit stuffy, so keep things airy!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云风大，体感略凉。注意防风，多添衣物。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with strong winds, feels cool. Remember to dress warmly!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云有风，气温略高。午后注意防晒和补水。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and breezy, a bit warm. Stay hydrated and mind the sun!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天风大，体感稍凉。出门防风，记得加件外套。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and windy, feels a bit chilly. Bring a jacket and mind the wind!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温偏高。注意补充水分，保持心情舒畅。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and warm. Stay hydrated and keep a cheerful mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感舒适。虽无阳光，也要保持好心情哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels pleasant. Even without sun, keep your spirits bright!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安小雨湿润，体感微凉。出门带伞，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an has light rain and humidity, feels cool. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天潮湿，体感稍闷。注意通风，保持清爽。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and humid, feels a bit muggy. Keep things airy and fresh!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天凉爽，体感舒适。出门散步，享受惬意。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast and cool, feels comfortable. Enjoy a pleasant stroll outside!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天湿润，体感微凉。注意保暖，小心着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and damp, feels cool. Stay warm to avoid catching a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天有风，体感舒适。风力稍大，注意防风哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and breezy, feels pleasant. Mind the wind outside!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云风大，体感舒适。风力不小，出门注意防风！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and windy, feels pleasant. Strong winds, mind your step!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天风大湿冷，体感很凉。多穿衣服，注意保暖防寒！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast, windy, damp, and very cold. Bundle up to stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云风大，体感偏凉。出门多加衣，小心着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and windy, feels cool. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
